tree.heading: Prize competition
tree.text: The term “prize competition” means the competition for the award of the Genius Prize for Save Our Seas Innovations established under section 1972 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Commerce.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 4231 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 119–65.
